MUST_requirements.unit_notes: _set handler correctly stores key-value pair. Value supports spaces via ' '.join(args[1:]). Overwrite of existing key verified.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: Cross-command verified: SET → GET returns exact value. SET → EXISTS → TRUE. SET overwrite of SETEX key clears TTL (expiry.pop).

MUST_requirements.description: GET <key> returns value or ERR key_not_found
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Returns exact value on hit, ERR key_not_found on miss. Includes _is_expired cleanup before lookup.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: GET after SETEX expiry returns ERR key_not_found (expired keys treated as non-existent). GET after DEL returns ERR key_not_found. GET after FLUSH returns ERR key_not_found.

MUST_requirements.description: DEL <key> removes key, ERR key_not_found if missing
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Returns OK on successful delete, ERR key_not_found for missing key. Cleans up _expiry entry. _is_expired called first.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: DEL → GET → ERR key_not_found (full lifecycle verified). DEL → EXISTS → FALSE. DEL on SETEX-expired key returns ERR key_not_found (expiry cleanup before delete check).

MUST_requirements.description: KEYS lists all keys, one per line, terminated by END
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Empty store returns only END. Non-empty returns keys separated by newline, terminated by END. _cleanup_expired() called before listing.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: KEYS after SET + SETEX expiry: expired keys excluded. KEYS after FLUSH: only END. KEYS output is newline-separated (UNIX convention).

MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Empty store returns COUNT 0. Non-empty returns correct count. _cleanup_expired() called before counting.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: COUNT reflects SET/DEL/FLUSH changes correctly. COUNT after SETEX expiry excludes expired keys. COUNT after MSET batch correctly reflects all committed keys.

MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Returns TRUE for existing key, FALSE for missing key. _is_expired cleanup before check.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: EXISTS after SETEX expiry returns FALSE. EXISTS after DEL returns FALSE. EXISTS after SET returns TRUE.

MUST_requirements.description: FLUSH removes all keys, returns OK
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Clears both _data and _expiry dictionaries. Returns OK.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: FLUSH → COUNT 0 verified. FLUSH → KEYS → END verified. FLUSH clears SETEX expiry data as well. Post-FLUSH operations on empty store correctly return errors/miss indicators.

MUST_requirements.description: OK for successful SET and DEL
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: SET returns exact 'OK' (not substring match). DEL returns exact 'OK'.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: Response format consistent across all success paths. MSET returns 'OK <n>', SETEX returns 'OK', APPEND returns 'OK <new_length>' — all conforming to OK-prefix protocol.

MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Unknown command, empty command, and whitespace-only command all return ERR unknown_command. Command matching is case-insensitive.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: Unrecognized command does not affect store state. Dispatch table extensible — missing handlers (TTL, RENAME, TYPE, DUMP) correctly fall through to unknown_command.

MUST_requirements.description: Maximum key length enforced, ERR key_too_long
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Key > 64 chars rejected. Key == 64 chars accepted. _append() fix verified: key length check now present (line 276). All four key-creation paths (_set, _mset, _setex, _append) enforce M10.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: BUG FIXED: _append() previously lacked key length check, allowing M10 bypass via APPEND <65_char_key> val. Fix confirmed at line 276 of protocol.py. All creation paths now consistently enforce M10.

MUST_requirements.description: Maximum value size enforced, ERR value_too_large
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: Value > 1024 chars rejected. Value == 1024 chars accepted. Enforced in _set, _mset, _setex, and _append (checks resulting value length).
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: APPEND value overflow: if new_value > 1024, error returned BEFORE writing to _data, preserving original value. MSET validation phase catches oversized values before commit phase.

MUST_requirements.description: Maximum keys enforced, ERR store_full, updates allowed
MUST_requirements.unit_notes: 101st new key → ERR store_full. Update of existing key at capacity → OK. MSET at capacity with new keys → ERR store_full with atomic rollback.
MUST_requirements.integration_notes: MSET capacity check uses dedup (new_key_names set) to correctly count unique new keys. SETEX and APPEND also enforce capacity for new-key paths. Expired keys cleaned up before capacity check, freeing slots.

SHOULD_requirements.unit_notes: Two-phase atomic commit validated. Odd number of arguments returns ERR unknown_command. Key/value limits and capacity enforced. Returns OK <n>.
SHOULD_requirements.integration_notes: Atomicity verified: validation failure prevents any writes. Capacity check with batch dedup correct. MSET with mixed existing+new keys correctly counts unique new keys for capacity. Duplicate keys within batch handled (last value wins).

SHOULD_requirements.description: MGET <k1> <k2> ... returns values, NIL for missing, END terminated
SHOULD_requirements.unit_notes: Returns values for existing keys, NIL for missing, END terminator. No arguments returns ERR unknown_command.
SHOULD_requirements.integration_notes: MGET with mixed existing/missing keys produces correct output. NIL is distinct from empty value. _is_expired called per-key for proper expiry handling in batch.

SHOULD_requirements.description: TTL <key> returns remaining seconds, -1 if no expiry, ERR key_not_found
SHOULD_requirements.unit_notes: Not implemented. No TTL handler in dispatch table. _execute() falls through to ERR unknown_command.
SHOULD_requirements.integration_notes: TTL is the only SHOULD requirement not addressed. SETEX infrastructure (self._expiry dict, _is_expired, _cleanup_expired) exists and could support TTL implementation. Not blocking — 4/5 SHOULD ≥ 3 threshold.

SHOULD_requirements.unit_notes: Seconds parsing robust: non-numeric, zero, negative all return ERR invalid_seconds. Expired keys treated as non-existent by GET/EXISTS. Key/value limits and capacity enforced.
SHOULD_requirements.integration_notes: SETEX → GET (within TTL) returns value. SETEX → GET (after TTL) returns ERR key_not_found. SETEX → SET (overwrite) clears TTL — value persists past original TTL. Expiry timestamps use time.time() + seconds. SETEX does not affect non-expiry keys in COUNT/KEYS.

SHOULD_requirements.description: APPEND <key> <value> appends or creates, returns OK <new_length>
SHOULD_requirements.unit_notes: Append to existing key concatenates and returns new length. Create new key if missing. Key length, value size, and capacity limits all enforced (M10 fix applied).
SHOULD_requirements.integration_notes: APPEND value overflow: returns ERR value_too_large without modifying original value. APPEND at full capacity for new key: ERR store_full. APPEND key with spaces in value: correct concatenation via ' '.join(). APPEND return value is resulting string length.

MAY_requirements.notes: No RENAME handler in dispatch table.

MAY_requirements.description: TYPE <key> returns type of stored value
MAY_requirements.notes: No TYPE handler in dispatch table.

MAY_requirements.description: DUMP returns all key-value pairs as <key>=<value>
MAY_requirements.notes: No DUMP handler in dispatch table.

integration_analysis.method: Static code trace-through of cross-command interaction paths

scenarios_verified.name: Full lifecycle (SET → GET → EXISTS → DEL → GET)
scenarios_verified.detail: State flows correctly through all command transitions.

scenarios_verified.name: SETEX expiry integration (SETEX → GET within TTL → GET after TTL → KEYS → COUNT)
scenarios_verified.detail: Expired keys properly cleaned up and excluded from all query commands.

scenarios_verified.name: MSET atomic rollback (MSET with validation failure preserves prior state)
scenarios_verified.detail: Two-phase commit: no partial writes on validation failure.

scenarios_verified.name: MSET capacity atomicity (MSET at capacity boundary with new keys)
scenarios_verified.detail: Correct dedup of new keys. Atomic rollback when capacity exceeded.

scenarios_verified.name: SET overwrites SETEX TTL
scenarios_verified.detail: SET calls _expiry.pop(key, None), removing TTL. Value persists past original expiry.

scenarios_verified.name: Error recovery (error does not corrupt prior state)
scenarios_verified.detail: Commands are independent. Error on one command leaves other keys intact.

scenarios_verified.name: APPEND value overflow preserves original
scenarios_verified.detail: new_value > MAX_VALUE_SIZE check executes before _data[key] = new_value assignment.

scenarios_verified.name: MGET mixed existing/missing/NIL
scenarios_verified.detail: Correct NIL for missing keys, values for existing, END terminator.
